# zyxel_firewall (Resource)

Manages router-wide Firewall General settings and DoS Protection Blocking. Create adopts and configures the built-in settings; changes update in place. Only the documented General and DoS fields are written, leaving ACL rules and other settings untouched. Manage only one instance per router, including across Terraform states. Destroy stops management without changing the router. Live writes have not been verified on hardware.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "zyxel_firewall" "router" {
  ipv4_enabled           = true
  ipv6_enabled           = true
  security_level         = "medium"
  dos_protection_enabled = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `dos_protection_enabled` (Boolean) Whether DoS Protection Blocking is enabled.
- `ipv4_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the IPv4 firewall is enabled.
- `ipv6_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the IPv6 firewall is enabled.
- `security_level` (String) Firewall security level as shown in the UI: `low`, `medium` (recommended), or `high`. These map to router Level_GUI values Off, Low, and High respectively.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Singleton identity, always `router`. Use `router` as the import ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import zyxel_firewall.router router
```
